name: Best minimum distance of binary linear codes

limitations: 公开方法对照距离8，本地传统搜索距离19。公开距离24矩阵未取到。

source_review.definition: Maximize minimum nonzero codeword weight of a k-dimensional binary linear code of length n. Retain[68,15] and add[80,20] and[100,20].
source_review.primary_source: Sol checked exact-parameter Grassl BKLC pages, [80,20] gives25–30 and [100,20] gives34–40. Compared every stored generator polynomial exponent to the source. Both construct from Chen Zhi1994 quasi-cyclic polynomials. C02 builds 3x27 blocks and punctures coordinate81; C03 builds 3x33 blocks and appends a zero coordinate. Source vintage is recorded; no matching optimality proof was found in checked sources.
source_review.independent_method: Sol personally ran the human QC reconstruction and the fixed reference. Independent set closure under XOR of integer-packed rows gives exactly1048576 codewords and minimum nonzero weights25 and34. This differs from the checker Gray traversal. Accepted rank, objective, and exact bit checks passed; duplicated generator row rejected.
source_review.admission: Five strict programs per config and full score-claim invariance, replay, cold export and error/nonfinite/timeout checks passed. During review the new reference loader initially returned weaker search matrices; it now returns exact archived public generators for new configs. Original C01 reference19 and separate SOTA24 are preserved, with final full runner recheck.
